concept: Specify the clustering objective before adding weights

concept: Three regularizers produce three different shrinkage rules
historical_origin: Assistant discussion of weighted clustering, regularization, online updates and statistical learning methods.

This keeps or removes entire groups and provides a precise intermediate choice between coordinate sparsity and uniform ridge shrinkage. Each of these proximal maps is nonexpansive: if outputs x,y correspond to inputs z,w, monotonicity of the convex subgradient gives〈(z−x)−(w−y),x−y〉≥0.
